overview.description: The GraniteShares YieldBOOST Technology ETF (TECY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly income. The fund strategy involves writing put options on a 3x daily leveraged ETF tied to the S&P Technology Select Sector Index. TECY was launched on May 5, 2026 and is issued by GraniteShares.
